title: 555 Timer Formulas
summary: astable frequency/duty-cycle and monostable pulse-width equations for the classic 555 timer.
body:
in astable mode the 555 oscillates: the capacitor charges through R1 + R2 and
discharges through R2, so the duty cycle is always above 50% in the basic
circuit. in monostable mode a trigger produces a single pulse set by R and C.
gotchas: the basic astable can never reach exactly 50% duty (R1 makes it >50%); add a diode across R2 to approach 50%
the bipolar NE555 sinks large current spikes on the supply at each transition; decouple with 100nF at the chip
use the CMOS 7555 for low power, higher frequency, and less supply glitching
